Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle now. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the two openers for India Women. Australia Women going with spin straightaway as Ashleigh Gardner is set to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE CHASE ...

Right then, Australia Women have posted a huge total on the board and will be confident enough to defend this. India Women, on the other hand have the quality in their batting line-up, but they need to perform at their best to gun this down. It is going to be an exciting chase. Stay tuned for the second essay.

It was the same story for India Women as they struggled to get past the top three batters of Australia Women. They looked out of ideas in the middle and could not execute their plans. They were also a bit sloppy in the field as Richa Ghosh and Deepti Sharma dropped both Mooney and McGrath respectively which could have made a difference to the total. The only wicket that fell was taken by Deepti Sharma. Renuka Singh pulled things back a bit by bowling a good last over. India Women know that it is not going to be an easy chase, but they have to come out with a positive mindset and try to take the game deep to have any chance of levelling the series.

Australia Women have put on another scintillating batting display here. They were just unstoppable and looked to take the attack to their opponents right from the start. It all started with Alyssa Healy giving them a perfect start by playing some lusty blows. Once she fell, it was Beth Mooney and Tahlia McGrath who continued their good form and played shots all around the park. They were one step ahead from the India Women bowlers and punished them at will. Both batters remained unbeaten and scored brilliant fifties, and added 158 runs together to the total. Now, it is up to their bowlers to back up the good job done by their batters and defend this total to take a 2-0 lead in the series.

Take a bow Beth Mooney and Tahlia McGrath! It was the same duo which proved to be the difference in the 1st T20I, and they have managed to repeat their masterclass. These two now have broken the record for the highest second-wicket partnership for Australia Women.

Renuka Singh bowls this wide outside off on a fuller length, Tahlia McGrath charges down the wicket and slices the ball to short third man for a single. Good over from Renuka Singh but Australia Women have a massive total on the board!
Really full once again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath attempts a reverse sweep but misses as the ball goes through to the keeper.

FIVE WIDES! Really unfortunate for Renuka Singh! She watches Tahlia McGrath go across to the off side and bowls this really full and well outside the off stump. Tahlia McGrath leaves the ball at the last moment and the keeper is nowhere close to the ball. It runs away behind the wicket for four extra runs. Wide called by the umpire and the India Women players are not happy with the decision!
Another yorker length delivery bowled outside off, Beth Mooney looks to paddle this but mistimes the ball towards short third man for a run.
Fires in another yorker outside the off pole, Tahlia McGrath goes across to the offside and digs this towards deep square leg for a run.
Bowls this full and wide outside the off stump, Beth Mooney gets across to the off side and sweeps this to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Renuka Singh bowls a yorker wide outside off, Beth Mooney looks to dig this out but misses. A valuable dot ball for India Women!
Renuka Singh to bowl the last over. She has conceded 30 runs in her three overs. Can she keep Australia Women under 190?
Bowls this short and wide outside off, Beth Mooney mistimes her cut shot towards deep cover for a single and will keep strike for the last over.
FOUR! Make that three! It is raining boundaries! This is full as well and outside off, Beth Mooney stays in the crease and heaves this towards deep mid-wicket to collect four more runs.

FOUR! Two boundaries in a row once again! This is bowled full and outside off, Beth Mooney strokes this beautifully towards wide long off. The fielder puts in a dive but can only push the ball towards the rope.

FOUR! Beth Mooney chooses her spot in the field to find a boundary! This is short and served really wide as Beth Mooney goes well across the stumps. She manages to reach the ball and pull it towards deep square leg for four runs.
Floats this one full and in line with the stumps, Tahlia McGrath clips this down to long on for another single.
Deepti Sharma bowls this short and outside off after seeing Beth Mooney shuffles down the pitch. Beth Mooney punches this to deep cover for one.
Deepti Sharma (3-0-16-1) to bowl the penultimate over.
Full once again and outside the off stump, Beth Mooney drives this to deep cover and takes a single this time.

This is bowled full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney strokes wide of deep cover and they look for twp. Tahlia McGrath is struggling to make it back to the keeper's end. The throw comes in and the bowler whips the bails off but the replays show that the batter has made it into the crease. Still no wicket for India Women!
Devika Vaidya sees Tahlia McGrath go across to the off side and serves this wide outside off. Tahlia McGrath reaches for it and thumps the ball to deep cover for a single.
Bowls this wide outside off just inside the tram line on a fuller length. Tahlia McGrath swings her bat but misses.
Bowls this full as well and outside the off stump, Beth Mooney drives this to deep cover-point and takes one.
FOUR! Another over starts with a boundary! Devika Vaidya floats this full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney charges down the wicket and lofts the ball towards deep cover for four runs.
Devika Vaidya comes back into the attack. She has conceded 23 runs in her two overs.
Bowls this full once again and well outside the off pole, Beth Mooney gets on one knee and swats this to towards deep square leg for a single to retain strike.
Goes wide outside off on a fuller length, Beth Mooney goes well across the stumps and looks to paddle this fine. She does not connect this one.
Another full delivery outside off, Tahlia McGrath hits this hard towards cover and they steal a single.

FOUR! Make that two boundaries in a row and Tahlia McGrath is toying with the field here! A full delivery just outside off, Anjali Sarvani lofts this over the infield and gets the ball to long off for four more runs.

FOUR! That is sheer power from Tahlia McGrath! Anjali Sarvani bowls this really full and wide outside off, Tahlia McGrath swings hard at the ball and gets it towards deep square leg for another boundary.
Anjali Sarvani goes 'round the wicket and bowls this on a good length, outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to cut but gets a bottom edge down into the pitch.
This is flighted full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath strokes this down to long off and takes a single to keep strike.
Two dot balls in a row! This is slightly short and angled down leg, Tahlia McGrath looks to reverse sweep but does not connect cleanly.
Bowls a high full toss this time outside off, Tahlia McGrath takes a few steps forward and thumps this straight to cover. Rare dot ball.
Bowls this full and outside off, Beth Mooney shimmies down the wicket and makes the ball a full toss. She knocks this down to long off for one.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short once again and just outside the off stump, Beth Mooney pulls this towards deep backward square leg and collects four more runs.

FOUR! FIFTY for Beth Mooney as well! India Women are slightly losing the plot here and are feeding Australia Women with gifts! Radha Yadav bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Beth Mooney pulls this towards deep square leg for four runs.
Floated and around off, Beth Mooney lofts it towards long off for a run as well.
Tossed up, full and on off, Tahlia McGrath chips it towards long off for a single.

SIX! FIFTY FOR McGRATH! She gets to it in some style! This is flighted and on off, Tahlia McGrath skips down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie. This has been a great knock from her and she will look to take Australia Women to huge total now.
FOUR! Nicely played! This is quicker, full and on off, Tahlia McGrath goes down and drags her sweep well over the square leg fielder for a boundary. This is some brilliant batting from the Aussies.
Floated, full and on off, Beth Mooney works it towards long off for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Tahlia McGrath comes forwards and drills it towards deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Classy from Mooney! This is full and around off, Beth Mooney stays in her crease and drives it through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! Brilliant shot! Renuka Singh goes fuller and on the pads, Beth Mooney goes down and scoops this one towards the wide fine leg fence for a boundary.
Back of a length and outisde off, Tahlia McGrath shuffles across again and heaves it towards long on for one.
This is on a yorker length and outside off, Beth Mooney squeezes it towards short third man for a run.
Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves across, but mistimes here pull shot towards mid-wicket. They scamper across for a single as the fielder misses her at the bowler's end.
This is on a good length and on middle, Beth Mooney forces it towards long on for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Beth Mooney uses here feet and drills it towards long off for a single.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is flighted and outside off, Beth Mooney smashes it wide of deep point where Jemimah Rodrigues covers here ground well, dives to the right, but lets it through at the last moment for a boundary.
FOUR! Beth Mooney gets this one in the gap! This is tossed up, full and on middle, Beth Mooney goes down and nails her sweep towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Another single as this full delivery is slapped towards long on.
Flatter, full and on middle, Beth Mooney eases it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! This is tossed up, full and outside off, Beth Mooney gets to the pitch of the ball and thrashes it over point for a boundary.

Dropped! A tough chance though. This is floated, full and on off, Beth Mooney smashes it uppishly back towards the bowler where Deepti Sharma is a bit late to react and fails to grab it. A single is taken.
Quicker one, full and on leg, Tahlia McGrath misses her flick and the ball deflects off her pads towards square leg. A leg bye is taken.
Tossed up, full and on off, Beth Mooney skips down the track and forces it through covers for a single.

Flighted delivery, on off, Beth Mooney tries the reverse-sweep this time, but misses and the ball loops uo off here pads as Richa Ghosh grabs it. There is a stiffled appeal for a catch, but turned down.
Looped up, full and outside off, turining further away, Beth Mooney goes for the sweep, but misses it completely.
Floated, full and on middle, Tahlia McGrath works it past mid on for a single.
Deepti Sharma has been brought into the attack. The pick of the bowlers so far claiming the only wicket that has fallen.

Tahlia McGrath looking to go big but misses! Devika Vaidya bowls this quicker in the air and in line with the stumps on a fuller length. Tahlia McGrath goes for a massive heave but gets an inside edge onto her legs. The ball goes towards cover and they take another run.
Floats this one outside the off pole on a fullish length, Beth Mooney shimmies down and lofts this towards long off for one more.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Tahlia McGrath sweeps this hard but straight to the deep square leg fielder and they take a single.
Flights this one full and outside off, Beth Mooney shuffles down the wicket and heaves the ball towards the leg side. Mistimes it to deep mid-wicket for one.
This is slightly short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath rocks back and punches this to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Australia Women are playing shots at will here! Utter dominance! Devika Vaidya bowls this full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath reverse sweeps this to third man for another boundary.
FOUR! That has been played delicately! Anjali Sarvani bowls this on a good length and just outside off, Beth Mooney gets across and paddles this towards fine leg for four runs.
Bowls this slightly fuller and outside off stump. Tahlia McGrath looks to force this leg side but gets and inside edge onto her pads. The ball rolls towards short third man and they take one.
This is on a good length and outside off, Tahlia McGrath pushes at the ball and gets beaten by the pace. The ball lobs into the air but lands just short of point.

FOUR! Tahlia McGrath had all the time in the world to choose her spot! Anjali Sarvani bowls this short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath is across the stumps before the ball is bowled and pulls this towards deep square leg for four runs.
On a good length once again and outside the off stump, Beth Mooney cuts this to deep point and they take one more.
Anjali Sarvani bowls this on a good length and angling away from the batter. Tahlia McGrath strokes this to deep cover and collects one.
Anjali Sarvani (2-0-15-0) is back on.
Bowls this one in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Beth Mooney blocks this back towards the bowler.
Short and outside off, Beth Mooney taps this towards the point fielder.
FOUR! Slog sweeped for a boundary! Radha Yadav goes really full and outside off. Beth Mooney gets down on one knee and lofts the ball towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole, Tahlia McGrath shimmies down the wicket and drives this to deep cover for one.
Bowls this full and outside the off stump, Tahlia McGrath looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. Another enquiry from the bowler.
Radha Yadav bowls this full and wide outside off,  Beth Mooney knocks this to deep cover for a single.

FOUR! Third boundary in the over and a good one for Australia Women! Meghna Singh bowls this really short and wide outside off, Tahlia McGrath gets on top of the bounce and cuts this to deep point for four more runs.
This is on a good length and outside off, Beth Mooney pushes this to mid off and takes a quick single.

FOUR! Lucky boundary but they all count! Meghna Singh bangs this in short and wide outside off, Beth Mooney looks to pull this leg side but gets a top edge that goes just over the keeper and runs away for four runs.
Goes 'round the wicket to the left-hander and serves this on a good length, outside off. Beth Mooney slashes at the ball and finds the backward point fielder.
Bowls this one short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath cuts this to deep cover for one.

FOUR! What an outstanding shot from Tahlia McGrath! Meghna Singh bowls this full and angling down leg, Tahlia McGrath makes room on the leg side and drives this to the left of the mid off fielder and finds the boundary.
Meghna Singh comes into the attack now.
Fires this one full and wide outside off, Beth Mooney premeditates and looks to play this leg side but is beaten by the pace.
Short once again and outside off, Tahlia McGrath slaps this to the deep cover fielder and takes one.
Floated full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath strokes this straight to cover.

Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off pole. Tahlia McGrath comes across the line of the stumps and looks to sweep this. Misses and gets hit on the pads which results in a massive appeal from the bowler. The umpire remains unmoved.
Bowls this slight;y short and outside off, Beth Mooney rocks back and cuts this to deep point for a single.
Radha Yadav starts off with a flighted delivery full and in line with the stumps. Tahlia McGrath eases this to long on and takes one.

Floated, full and on off, Tahlia McGrath drives it towards covers where the Meghna Singh makes a good diving stop to her right. They cross. Australia Women are on 46 for one after the end of Powerplay.
Flighted delievery and outside off, Beth Mooney uses his feet and drills it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up, short and outside off, turning further away, Beth Mooney tries to reach for it, but fails to connect.
Short again and way outside off, Tahlia McGrath moves across towards it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Just over! This is short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath slices it hard and just over the leaping Radha Yadav at cover-point for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, full and on leg, Tahlia McGrath goes for the reverse-sweep, but misses.
Short again and on off, Tahlia McGrath slaps it towards covers for a run.
Anjali Sarvani pulls her length back and bowls this outside off, Tahlia McGrath goes for the cut again, but fails to connect this time.
On a length and on off, Tahlia McGrath pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Good placement! This is short of a length and outside off, Tahlia McGrath frees her arms and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary.

DROPPED! Anjali Sarvani bowls this back of a length and outside off, Tahlia McGrath looks to cut it away, but gets a thin bottom edge towards the keeper where Richa Ghosh fails to hold on to it. Tahlia McGrath gets a life.
This is full and on leg, Beth Mooney works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Tahlia McGrath gets off the mark in style! This is a bit short and on off, Tahlia McGrath uses her feet and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tahlia McGrath drives it back towards the bowler where Deepti Sharma has shy at the bowler's end, but Beth Mooney is safe.
Short and on middle, Tahlia McGrath cuts it towards point.

OUT! TAKEN! Deepti Sharma strikes! India Women get the breakthrough and it is the dangerous Alyssa Healy who is walking back to the hut. Deepti Sharma bowls this short again and outside off, Alyssa Healy tries to reach for it and slashes, but gets an top edge towards short third man where Devika Vaidya takes a nice catch. Australia Women lose their first. Also, Tahlia McGrath walks out to bat at number 3.
Commentary.Howout: c Devika Vaidya b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, short and on off, turning away, Beth Mooney slaps it towards extra cover for another run.
Deepti Sharma starts with short delivery and on off, Alyssa Healy cuts it towards covers where the fielder fumbles a bit and allows a single.
Full and on the pads, Beth Mooney tucks it away wide of deep mid-wicket for a brace. If the throw would have been better it would have been a close call at the bowler's end.
Short of a length and outside off, Beth Mooney cuts it wide of point where Devika Vaidya dives to her left to make the stop.
This is on a length and around off, Alyssa Healy taps it towards point for a single.
Goes fuller and on off, Alyssa Healy looks to dab it away, but gets a bottom edge over the stumps towards the leg slip region. The slip fielder collects it.
FOUR! Two in two! Excellent shot! Renuka Singh bowls this on a good length and on middle, Alyssa Healy gently strokes it past the bowler and wide of mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! Alyssa Healy is finding the fence with ease here! This is full and around off, Alyssa Healy carasses it behind square on the leg side for a boudnary.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is worked towards long on.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Healy! Anjali Sarvani bowls this a touch fuller and on the pads, Alyssa Healy stays there and flicks it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Alyssa Healy knocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Nice timing! This is full and on middle and leg, Alyssa Healy moves across a bit, and clips it towards the wide long on region where Shafali Verma dives to her right, but lets it through for a boudnary. She looks in some pain as her shoulder hit the ground hard when she dived.
Pulls her length back a bit, on off, shaping in again, Alyssa Healy slashes at it, but misses.
Close call! Anjali Sarvani serves this full and around off, shaping in a bit, Alyssa Healy looks to drive it, but gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball rolls just past the stumps.
Anjali Sarvani will share the attack and bowl from the other end.
On a length and on off, Beth Mooney blocks it to the leg side.
Goes fuller and on middle, shaping in, Alyssa Healy tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That is the first boundary of the inning! Renuka Singh lands this short and on middle, Alyssa Healy picks up the length early and pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Renuka Singh continues her fuller length, on off with the keeper up this time, Beth Mooney pushes it towards covers for a run.
This is full again and outside off, angling away, Beth Mooney lets it go to the keeper.
Renuka Singh starts with a fuller delivery, on off, Alyssa Healy drives it uppishly through extra covers for a single. Australia Women are underway straightaway!

We are ready for action! The umpires make their way out to the middle. The India Women players spread out and take their respective poitions in the field. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney will open the inning for Australia Women and will be looking to get off to a good start. Renuka Singh has been handed the new ball and will begin proceedings. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT- C.V Raman is pitchside. He says that the pitch is the sames as the previous game and we can expect a lot of runs in this game as well. Adds that the task is cut out for the bowlers, but the pacers might get some help if they hit the right lengths.

Alyssa Healy, the captain of Australia Women says that they are not really fuss about batting first. Adds that the the pitch looks a bit dry and they will try to put big runs on the board. Informs they have made two changes.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women says that they will bowl first. Explains that it is night game so it is better to chase. Mentions that they are bowling first so they will keep in mind what happened in the first game. Informs that they are going with the same team.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Devika Vaidya, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Anjali Sarvani, Meghna Singh, Renuka Singh.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (C/WK), Beth Mooney, Tahlia McGrath, Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Phoebe Litchfield (In place of Jess Jonassen), Kim Garth, Annabel Sutherland, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Heather Graham (In place of Grace Harris).
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of India Women  They have elected to BOWL first.

India Women had a good overall performance with the bat, with their openers getting them off to a brisk start and building the inning through the middle overs. Their lower order batters provided them with the much needed impetus and took them to a respectable total. It is their bowling department that proved to have an off-day and lacked the penetration to be able to break through the strong Australian top-order. In the end the visitors completed the chase with ease as the bowlers looked like they they had run out of ideas. Will we see a much more improved performance from the hosts as they look to level the series? Or will the Aussie juggernaut continue to bulldoze its way towards another win? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

Australia Women are unbeaten in the shortest format of the game this year and are a force to reckon with. They have a lethal batting lineup and it could be seen in the last game as they needed just their top three batters to overcome a competitive total. The middle order is yet to be exposed and they need to be careful that the lack of game time does not cause them to collapse in this game. They have wicket-takers in their bowling contingent but they will want to improve their performance in the death overs as they proved to be quite expensive in the last few overs in the previous game. The will want to seal this win and take a commanding 2-0 lead in this five-match series and put the pressure on the hosts.

Hello and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of the second T20I between India Women and Australia Women at the D Y Patil Sports Stadium with both teams looking for a crucial win in context of the series. Australia Women have taken an early lead going into this match and have another opportunity to consolidate this series with another victory. India Women had a great opportunity to start off well but surrendered their advantage and in they end surrered a massive loss that could dent their confidence. The visitors are definitely favorites going into this game but they will not be taking their opponents lightly.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is now time for the second T20I between Indian Women and Australia Women. It is Australia Women who have taken an early lead in this series with a convincing win in the first encounter. After being put to bat first, India Women posted 172 runs on the board which looked quite solid although the visitors chased it down with 9 wickets in hand and 11 balls to spare. This stat itself tells you a lot about this Australian squad. It is a talented group of players who are ruthless when they stride out on the pitch. Nevertheless, Australia Women would be hoping to put up a better performance with the ball in hand and restrict the opposition to a much lower score. India Women, on the other hand, look lackluster with the ball in hand. They certainly need to get in front of the whiteboard and get their strategies on point if they are to trouble the Australian batters. There are still a few matches left in this series but India Women would be hoping to shift the momentum on their side by leveling the series. This should be no less than a cracker. Can Australia Women make it two wins in two? Or Will India Women manage to put them on equal terms with the visitors? We shall find out together.
